quest.title: Rite of Descension
quest.description: In the land of Liyue by the sea, a city sits atop the solid bedrock. That city is Liyue Harbor, and it has flourished under the protection of its guardian Morax — also known as "Rex Lapis," the Geo Archon you have been looking for. You could not have arrived at a more fortuitous time, as the annual "Rite of Descension" has just begun. Every year on this day, Rex Lapis graces this land with his prophecy, giving guidance on the economic path Liyue should follow in the coming year.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x375, Mora x11550, Adventurer's Experience x4, Mystic Enhancement Ore x3

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Xigu Antiques isn't open yet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If you wanna find the Geo Archon, this is the only chance you'll get all year.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess it's a good thing Venti brought it up earlier, otherwise we definitely would've missed this year's Rite of Descension.

choices.text: Do you know when it is?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh... might be today, might also be tomorrow...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look, we're already in Liyue so let's go ask some of the locals.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, right. About the Geo Archon, "Morax..."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you know? The Mora that we use is named after this god.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But it's seen as impolite for people from outside Liyue to refer to the Geo Archon by that name.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So we should refer to the Geo Archon by the name Rex Lapis, like the people of Liyue do.

choices.text: Do you know where it is?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, Venti brought up the time, but Paimon... knows nothing about where it is... Ehe.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: Oh! Are you also visitors here for the Rite of Descension?

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: To think I've lived in Liyue all these years and never come to see this before.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: I guess it's like they say. Locals never visit the tourist spots.

dialogues.speaker: Guanhai
dialogues.text: I wish you well on your travels! Liyue always welcomes you!

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Rite of Descension... Oh yeah, that reminds me, isn't that today?

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Once a year, Rex Lapis bestows upon us his divine prediction, guiding us on how to run Liyue for the coming year.

dialogues.speaker: Linlang
dialogues.text: Last year it was the Yuheng of the Liyue Qixing that was given the honor of asking for the divine prediction.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ooh! Paimon knows this one!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Mondstadt is to freedom as Liyue is to contracts. Liyue has a strong focus on business and trade.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: The Liyue Qixing — the seven leaders of the seven enterprises of Liyue — hold true control over Liyue.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: That's what foreigners always say.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: But true control over Liyue will always be held by Rex Lapis.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: The Qixing is comprised of mere mortals. Rex Lapis is a god. Mondstadt's god is nowhere to be seen, whilst our god is forever with us.

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: Stay in Liyue long enough and you'll see...

response.speaker: Linlang
response.text: Given that you just left your godless city, it's time you experienced what it's like to be in a city whose god has walked with it through all of history.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: You too wish to bear witness to the Rite of Descension? Me too, we all do!

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: As a businessman myself, how could I not take interest in Liyue's most important business trends?

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: The seventeen predictions given last year made more than a few ripples throughout the industry.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: What's more, there has been a rumor going around that the Tianquan herself, Ningguang, has been acting secretly in the shadows...

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: She wants the rocks created by Geo Vision holders to be exempt from taxation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow... that's some super professional legal stuff that is!

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Haha. To be on the pulse of the predictions and the market is what makes this harbor what it is.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Among The Seven, Rex Lapis is the oldest deity.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: His keen sense of strategy is well trusted among his people.

dialogues.speaker: Bolai
dialogues.text: Understanding the predictions as soon as possible can make all the difference in making your fortune!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon heard that the best time to make a wish is today, during the Rite of Descension. {NICKNAME}, wanna give it a try?

talks.objective: Pray and make a wish at Yujing Terrace

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Oh, you also want a little adepti luck too?

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: Haha, seems you know a lot! Making a wish during this time is sure to get you the blessings of both the Adepti and Rex Lapis himself.

dialogues.speaker: Changshun
dialogues.text: I've already made my wish, so you can take this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Great, thanks!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #I wish I could find my {M#sister}{F#brother} soon...

talks.objective: Pray and make a wish at Yujing Terrace

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Your first time in Liyue? Actually, it's my first time to see the Rite of Descension too.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Ah, look! That's Ms. Ningguang of the Liyue Qixing!

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Only those who have control in Liyue can preside over the Rite of Descension.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: Oh yeah, not sure if you knew, but most of the adepti appear in the form of various beasts.

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: I heard that when attending these kinds of formal occasions, Rex Lapis himself appears as a celestial cross between two of Liyue's ancient mythical creatures...

dialogues.speaker: Ivanovich
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, I shouldn't interrupt your wish. Please, take this.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I wish I could get some leads from the Geo Archon...

talks.objective: Pray and make a wish at Yujing Terrace
Join the crowd and wait for the rite to begin

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa! Look at all the people...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wha... What's going on!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Did she just say Rex Lapis is...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Geo Archon... is... DEAD!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh no, the Millelith! Looks like they're nabbing suspects who got too close.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's freaking out. The killer is amongst us!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait... we got close... are we suspects!?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, where are you going?

choices.text: (It was a god we faced off against when we first arrived in this world too...)

dialogues.speaker: Yujing Terrace Infiltration AI1
dialogues.text: Someone assassinated Rex Lapis! You'd be wise to cooperate with our investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Yujing Terrace Infiltration AI1
dialogues.text: There's nowhere to run!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *panting* Phew... Paimon's exhausted...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So insensitive! You have no idea just how tiring floating arou— Wait!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Just who are you exactly?
Call me Childe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Childe? What, so we're supposed to dote on you?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Haha, no no, not at all. It's an alias of sorts.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: In Mondstadt, I don't suppose you came across a "Signora" by any chance?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Signora... Childe...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're Fatui! One of The Harbingers!

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Oh, no. Don't worry, I'm not looking for a fight.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Signora gave you quite the bad impression huh? Tsk, that woman... Can't say I'm a fan either.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Right, let's forget all about her, shall we? I'm here to help you.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Yes. Help.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I'm not a bad guy... Okay perhaps I'm kind of a bad guy, but I'm not here to give you any trouble.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Would it be too much to ask for you to keep the sword sheathed?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: #Haha, I thank you for your knightly nobility, {NICKNAME}.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: I heard of your deeds in Mondstadt, so I couldn't help but notice you during the proceedings back there.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: And because I had my eye on you the whole time, I know it wasn't you. Someone else was clearly behind it.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: But... regrettably, given I'm a Fatui envoy from Snezhnaya... there's no way I'd be trusted after something of this magnitude.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: The ruling Qixing of Liyue has always been overly suspicious of us.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well can you honestly blame them?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Hahaha. Guess I shouldn't try to deny that.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Okay, sure. Maintaining a distance between strangers is probably a good idea. Either way, I'm already used to it at this stage.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: But right now, if you want to clear yourselves of any suspicion — you need to get yourselves to Northland Bank.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Staying here isn't an option. As the old Liyue saying goes: "The walls have ears."

choices.text: I don't need help from the Fatui.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Come now, don't be like that.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Sure, I may be one of the Harbingers, but hear me out.

choices.text: Just what muscles does magical floating use exactly?

talks.objective: Talk to Childe at the Northland Bank

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Northland Bank...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Correct. This bank was opened here in Liyue by Snezhnaya.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Though everyone knows Liyue is the most enterprising in Teyvat, Snezhnaya is not short of change either.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yeah well, poorer nations don't seem the type to have diplomats that come around acting the way yours do towards the Knights of Favonius.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Eh-hehehehe...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: Here, let me give you this.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This is a...

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: I'm not sure, exactly. Sometimes, all money can buy is "things" and not a name for oneself.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: All I know is that it's a sigil. A sigil to keep the "mighty and illuminated adepti" from bringing harm to you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Adepti?

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: If you head north from the harbor, then west from Guili Plains, you will eventually reach a stone forest known as Jueyun Karst.

dialogues.speaker: Childe
dialogues.text: The people of Liyue believe it to be the abode of the adepti.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Legend or not, they believe it. As such, offerings to the adepti are made at its borders. Nobody dares venture in.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: But I have no need for believing — not when I know for a fact that the adepti truly exist.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hate to admit it but your Fatui intel seems alright. But, why would we go looking for adepti anyway?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Ha, oh my little friend. There are plenty of reasons mortals seek the blessings of adepti.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Money, health, love... But you... you will go for justice.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Justice?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: The Qixing will already have dispatched the Millelith. They'll be seeking out the assassin from amongst the onlookers.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: But how could a mere mortal kill a god that can sweep aside entire armies? Rex Lapis never gave up his power as a god.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: This level of crude response is beyond what is called for. How suspicious...

choices.text: You think they're trying to hide the true culprit?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Or... to hide something else. Hard to say.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Even now, the Northland Bank wouldn't be able to hold the Millelith off for long, but the adepti can clear you of any wrongdoing.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Liyue was founded by the Geo Archon and the adepti — of course, it was built by force.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Look for them. And be faster than the Qixing's messengers, so you may give your version of events first.

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: If there is anyone that can help you in Liyue now, it can only be the mighty and illuminated adepti.

choices.text: You think the Qixing did it and they're trying to pin it on someone else?

response.speaker: Childe
response.text: Your thinking is even more radical than my own, Honorary Knight.

dialogues.speaker: Tianquan's Assistant
dialogues.text: Halt. Those not involved in the proceedings are not permitted to go any further!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pfft... Killjoy...

dialogues.speaker: Millelith Soldier
dialogues.text: Halt. Those not involved in the proceedings are not permitted to go any further!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pfft... Killjoy...
